mathematics: Independent tests cover prefix scaling and reversal, signed values, powered and inverse units, compound numerator/denominator conversion, Celsius values versus differences, mechanical/electrical dimensions, function domains, exact nearest-grid rounding with an independent tie-breaking oracle, carry cases and trailing zeros, exact counts/factors, guard digits, sample means/ranges, signed reference discrepancies, zero-relative uncertainty, inclusive endpoint compatibility, and enumeration of endpoint/interior combinations for sums, differences, signed scaling, products, and positive-denominator quotients. Generator structures use 100-seed sweeps; lessons and screens use 50 seeds.
instruction: Five substantial original lessons include quick/full routes, 32 reasoned examples, five guided problems, five keyboard prediction activities with equivalent tables, varied practice, checkpoints, and targeted routing. MTH scientific notation and measurement-unit families retain their source semantics and progress identities. Full physics/lab packs are honestly identified as planned in this baseline.
accessibility: All overview/lesson pages passed Axe WCAG 2 A/AA and WCAG 2.1 AA checks at desktop and 390x844 mobile size, without overflow or KaTeX errors. Activities support keyboard prediction, wrong-answer feedback, changed-control reset, and invalid-input alerts. Desktop overview and mobile prefix/bound screenshots were inspected.
sources: Precise OpenStax University Physics Volume 1 sections 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.6; College Physics 2e section 1.3; BIPM prefix table; NIST SP 811 chapters 4, 7, section 8.5; and NIST TN 1297 sections 2.1–2.4 are verified in resources.json. Instruction is original and distinguishes bounded intervals from unstated statistical confidence.
